title: 78 Woodlawn Park Avenue, Firhouse, Dublin 24
description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are delighted to present this beautiful three-bedroom, two-bathroom semi-detached family home to the market, ideally located on a peaceful cul de sac overlooking a large green area in the ever-sought-after Woodlawn Park Avenue, Firhouse, Dublin 24.

Situated in the popular Dublin 24 area, this property enjoys an enviable location. Firhouse Shopping Centre, Old Bawn Shopping Centre, and The Sqaure Shopping Centre, are just a short drive away, offering a vibrant mix of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Families will appreciate the proximity to several well-regarded schools, while nature lovers will delight in the nearby Dodder Valley Park, perfect for leisurely walks or outdoor activities.

Commuting is effortless with excellent transport links. Dublin Bus routes, including the 49, 65b S8 and S6, provide convenient and reliable access to the city centre and surrounding areas. The M50 motorway, just minutes away, offers quick connections to Dublin Airport, the greater Dublin area, and beyond. Whether you're traveling for work, school, or leisure, this location ensures that everything you need is within easy reach.

Bright, airy and most spacious internal living accommodation of c. 102 sqm compromises of entrance porch, hallway with ample storage, large living room with fireplace & bay window and open plan kitchen/dining area with fully fitted kitchen. On the first floor you have three spacious bedrooms (one master ensuite) with built in wardrobes and main family bathroom which comes fully tiled. To the rear of the property you have a private & enclosed garden of the lowest maintenance with a highly sought after west facing orientation making it perfect for relaxing on them long sunny summer evenings, you also have a decking area to the rear. The front provides ample off-street parking on a beautiful driveway on a peaceful cul de sac with very minimal passing traffic and overlooking a large green area.

This stunning three-bedroom home has been thoughtfully refreshed to provide a modern, comfortable living space, ideal for any growing family looking to settle roots in a fantastic area.

Number 78 Woodlawn Park Avenue comes to the market in superb condition throughout having been lovingly maintained by its current owners with no expense spared when upgrading in recent years, it has plenty of additional features such as generous living space, gas fired central heating, spacious bedrooms and ample parking to name but a few.

Contact Ray Cooke Auctioneers today to arrange a viewing and see all that this home has to offer!
